findings.title: The U-shape is an envelope stitched from two different approach directions, and the entire rising branch is a 1-of-24 azimuth knife edge
findings.evidence: Computed from `t3w_reach1_results.json /cells`, limit_set = v6_clip, max over the 24 Delta-psi values per radius, with the count of feasible azimuths: r=0.100 -> 55.469 at Delta-psi=180, 1/24; 0.125 -> 47.344 at 180, 5/24; 0.150 -> 40.313 at 180, 24/24; 0.175 -> 34.375 at 180; 0.200 -> 28.906 at 180; 0.225 -> 30.781 at Delta-psi=0; ... 0.350 -> 57.656 at 0, 3/24; 0.375 through 0.525 -> 1/24 each; 0.550 -> none. At fixed Delta-psi = 0 there is no U at all: r=0.100 and 0.125 are infeasible at every theta, then the ceiling rises monotonically 6.875 -> 81.25. So the left arm of the "U" exists only for Delta-psi = 180 (leaning back toward the base) and the right arm only for Delta-psi = 0.
findings.consequence_for_headline: "theta_max vs r is U-shaped: 55.5 at r=0.10, minimum 28.9 at r=0.20" must be qualified as a max-over-azimuth envelope whose two branches come from opposite approach directions, and every r >= 0.375 number must carry "1 of 24 azimuths feasible". As written it reads as a property of radius; it is a property of radius crossed with a direction that flips.

findings.title: HARD RULE #5: the code is compliant, but the planned sentence "90.0 deg under both hardware limit sets" is not — one of those two sets is wider than the robot's own URDF, by the run's own audit
findings.evidence: The rule text is narrow: `AGENTS.md:249` "**JOINT_LIMITS 제거 금지** — 하드웨어 보호" and `AGENTS.md:269` "`JOINT_LIMITS` 코드 제거 금지 (HARD RULE #5)". Nothing was deleted, and `t3w_reach1_results.json /provenance` = isaac_used false, physics_used false, robot_used false, rng_draws 0, p10_sha256_16 "63c6b2127d969e32" == the frozen pin in `START_HERE.md:581`. So the letter holds. The strongest case that it does NOT: `_evaluate` (script:218) rebinds the live clip per cell — `p10.V6_LIMITS_DEG = {k: tuple(v) for k, v in limits.items()}` — and one of the sets it installs is recorded by the run's own audit as wider than the robot model: `/limit_audit/claudemd_table_vs_urdf_disagreements` gives shoulder 110.0 vs urdf 90.00021 and elbow (-70,190) vs urdf (-57.296, 169.0225), both with "claudemd_wider_hi": true, and `/limit_audit/note` says "where it is WIDER than the URDF the 52nd theta_max for that row is optimistic". `t3w_prereg.md` C-2 adds that the row is a hybrid whose base bound is the v6 clip, not the CLAUDE.md table at all.
